source.dataset: NIST Genome in a Bottle HG002

selection.rule: VCF POS inside interval; not allele overlap or a benchmark BED intersection
selection.transformation: Retain all original header bytes and complete selected rows unchanged; no identifier, genotype, allele, build or sample edits. No result-based selection.

references.role: Previously frozen minimal ClinVar-only source-reference database; other sources empty
references.reconstruction: docs/clinvar-reference-evaluation.md; retain the references.db from the frozen reference evaluation

rights_and_privacy.terms: NIST data-use policy in the pinned release README; preserve acknowledgment and applicable notices, identify date/nature of extraction. Not relicensed as MIT or CC0.
rights_and_privacy.identifiability: Public broad PGP consent does not make HG002 anonymous. No profile enrichment, names, phenotypes or individual health interpretations.
rights_and_privacy.local_only: Original VCF, original headers, selected rows, evidence, logs, run and replay artifacts remain outside Git, CI and hosted AI agents.
rights_and_privacy.public_candidate: Reviewed protocol, exact source citations/version/URLs, integrity hashes and aggregate processing counts only. Hashes are provenance, not anonymization.

interpretation: Input handling and conserved accounting only. No benchmark BED is applied; the smvar VCF includes structural variants. No variant-call accuracy, pathogenicity, population, clinical, whole-genome or consumer-array performance estimate. Execution/accounting success is separate from input support; zero findings are not a negative genetic test.
